messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "risk of depression if discontinued during pregnancy"
set: ["risk of depression if discontinued during pregnancy", "depression comes back if discontinued during pregnancy", "hypothyroidism during pregnancy may increase risk of miscarriage", "hypothyroidism during pregnancy may increase risk of high blood pressure in pregnancy", "may increase risk of unintended pregnancy", "may cause complications during pregnancy", "should be used during pregnancy only if clearly needed", "dose needs may be different during pregnancy", "risk of permanent loss of vision if untreated", "may increase risk of neural tube defects in early pregnancy", "risk of overdose", "risk of addiction", "risk of death", "may have relapse of depression if stop taking antidepressant", "seizure during pregnancy could harm mother and baby", "losing weight during pregnancy could harm the unborn baby even if overweight"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
